useful_delta: Recovered the existing Agent Network/EPOCH/work-item lifecycle and designed a concrete derived Control Room that does not create a new authority or mutable status bottleneck. The key implementation gap is now explicit: coordination/** writes already trigger runtime compilation and a new EPOCH, but build-agent-runtime.mjs does not scan delegated JOB/runs/returns/INTEGRATION subtrees, so parent batch awareness is not yet compiled. The proposed solution is a compiler-native, per-Chat-Object Control Room projection with hash-based PRE_RESPONSE refresh, objective partial/full batch readiness, explicit missed-launch visibility, conservative staleness semantics and minimal human-facing status.

existing_foundation: Agent Network v3 already provides a cheap EPOCH, derived Network/Convergence views, independent worker-status objects and collision/dependency events; Control Room should extend these derived views rather than replace them.
The delegated-work model already defines durable JOB -> independent Run -> RETURN -> parent integration, with missing run meaning NOT_LAUNCHED and DONE requiring durable return evidence.
B-ZEROMEM-01 passed the observed fresh-chat canary and explicitly left compiled aggregate batch status as an unimplemented limitation.
The main runtime workflow is triggered by changes under coordination/**, so delegated run/return commits already cause the runtime compiler to run and the global EPOCH to advance.

The current build-agent-runtime.mjs discovers workstreams from PACK.json and worker status from coordination/network/workers, but does not discover delegated work-items/*/JOB.json, runs/*.json, returns/*.json or INTEGRATION.json. Therefore EPOCH can signal that something changed while the parent still lacks a compact delegated-work projection.
Run WORKING updates are intentionally material-state updates, not heartbeat traffic. Therefore elapsed time alone cannot truthfully convert an active run into FAILED.

derived_truth_rules.not_launched: A required Work Item with no effective run object is NOT_LAUNCHED.
derived_truth_rules.active: A non-superseded effective run in CLAIMED, STARTED or WORKING is active under the current run contract.
derived_truth_rules.returned: A return is durable only when the return artifact exists; a return_ref should resolve to that artifact.
derived_truth_rules.done: Count DONE only when the effective run says DONE and its durable RETURN exists. A DONE-without-return state is an invariant violation, not successful completion.
derived_truth_rules.boundary_or_failed: BOUNDARY and FAILED are explicit states with reasons/evidence; do not infer them from silence.
derived_truth_rules.consumption: RETURN existence and worker DONE do not imply REVIEWED, INTEGRATED, Human Accepted, Current or Served. Consumption/integration remains a separate parent/steward decision.
derived_truth_rules.multiple_runs: Do not choose a winner merely by latest timestamp. Respect explicit SUPERSEDED/retry lineage; if retry authority is unresolved, expose all effective runs/ambiguity to the parent rather than inventing canonicality.

facts.current_runtime_gap: The durable write path is already event-like at the backend because GitHub coordination writes trigger runtime compilation, but there is no compiled delegated-work/control-room read model. This is why current orchestration can be durable yet still require targeted repository inspection by a parent.
facts.edge_constraint: A ChatGPT parent cannot be asynchronously interrupted by a GitHub event while no turn is executing. The practical architecture is event-driven durable compilation on the backend plus cheap pull-on-turn refresh in PRE_RESPONSE, not conversational polling or heartbeat loops.

candidates.title: Compiler-native derived Control Room
candidates.recommendation: Extend the existing runtime compiler to derive Control Room state from canonical JOB/Run/RETURN/integration evidence. Do not let workers maintain one shared aggregate status file.
candidates.optional_scaling: If one Chat Object becomes large, batch details may be split into stable batch URLs while control-room.json remains a compact summary/index.

candidates.title: Compiler discovery strategy
design: Add delegated-work discovery that scans coordination/workstreams/**/work-items/*/JOB.json and reads sibling runs/*.json, returns/*.json and optional INTEGRATION/consumption evidence.
Group derived state by parent_chat_object_id and batch_id.

Resolve required Work Items from an explicit batch declaration/Work Board when present; otherwise use the declared batch membership in JOB/board evidence. Never infer membership from newest-looking files.
Reuse Agent Network convergence for collision/dependency events; store event refs in Control Room instead of implementing a second collision engine.
Keep public projection sanitized and metadata-only.

rules.partial_review_ready: true when at least one durable unconsumed RETURN exists; parent may inspect useful results without waiting for N/N when doing so is valuable.
rules.full_reconciliation_ready: true when every required Work Item is terminal or explicitly waived/superseded under valid parent policy, and there is return/evidence to reconcile. This may be true even if a worker ended at BOUNDARY/FAILED.
rules.success_complete: true only when every required Work Item is DONE with durable RETURN evidence.
rules.terminal_with_gaps: all required items terminal but one or more are FAILED/BOUNDARY or lack valid return evidence; do not report this as N/N success.

candidates.title: Missed-launch visibility
rules: Always expose objective not_launched_required from required JOBs lacking run evidence.
When siblings have started and a required item has no run, surface PARTIAL_LAUNCH or POSSIBLE_MISSED_LAUNCH with its launch_code.
Reserve definitive MISSED_LAUNCH for an explicit batch launch expectation/deadline/grace rule or parent evidence that the launch was intended. Silence alone does not prove human error.
If human action is truly required, the minimal status should name only the missing launch code(s), not ask the human to reconstruct the batch from memory.

candidates.title: Stale visibility without heartbeat noise
rules: Use timestamps only to derive STALE_CANDIDATE, never automatic FAILED.
A stale threshold should be batch/job/profile policy such as stale_after, not a universal hard-coded timeout.
Escalate from stale candidate only through explicit terminal evidence, parent supersession/retry policy or another authoritative signal.
BIG-07 should own retry/relaunch/supersession mechanics; Control Room owns visibility and attention state.

candidates.title: PRE_RESPONSE refresh strategy
algorithm: Resolve bound Chat Object identity as today.
If EPOCH is unchanged, reuse the previously loaded Control Room summary unless the user explicitly requests worker/batch status.
If EPOCH changed, read a tiny control-room-index.json containing per-Chat-Object semantic hashes and URLs.
If this Chat Object's control_room_hash is unchanged, do not load the full Control Room; unrelated repository activity caused the EPOCH change.
If the hash changed, fetch only this Chat Object's control-room.json and evaluate attention/readiness before interpreting the user's request.
When review/integration is now the highest-value autonomous action and authority allows it, the parent should perform it instead of assigning the human a coordination chore.
Surface status to the human only when the state changes the next useful action, requires a human launch/approval, reaches a real boundary/collision, or the human asks for status.

candidates.title: Minimal human-facing status
rules: Silent by default when worker state does not change the current action.
On explicit status request, prefer one compact batch line such as: B-BIGPIC: 8/18 started · 5 returned · 3 active · 10 not launched.
Attention priority: real HARD collision/human boundary > required human launch > full reconciliation ready > partial progress.
If all required items are terminal but one boundary remains, report terminal composition, not false success: 18/18 terminal · 17 returns · 1 boundary · reconciliation ready.
Only report successful N/N when all required items satisfy DONE + durable RETURN.
Do not narrate every STARTED/WORKING transition and do not expose private Capture/transcript payloads.

options.reason: Reuses the existing runtime build trigger, EPOCH, Agent Network convergence and read-only derived-state model. Gives fresh parents O(1)-ish targeted awareness and scales without a mutable coordination bottleneck.
Requires no shared compiler change but becomes tool-heavy and repetitive at scale; useful only while the compiled projection does not yet exist.
Violates independent worker-state invariants, creates write contention and makes aggregate truth vulnerable to stale/last-writer-wins updates.

candidates.title: Falsifying test matrix
tests: 0/N: N required JOBs and no runs -> all NOT_LAUNCHED; no invented active workers.
Partial launch: 5/6 required runs -> exactly one NOT_LAUNCHED and no false N/N readiness.
Partial return: returned/active/not-launched counts remain independently correct.
All success: every required run DONE with durable return -> success_complete and full_reconciliation_ready.
Boundary batch: all required terminal with one BOUNDARY -> full_reconciliation_ready may be true while success_complete is false.
DONE without RETURN -> invariant violation and not counted as successful done.
RETURN exists while run remains STARTED -> expose lifecycle inconsistency rather than silently normalizing it.
Old active run beyond policy threshold -> STALE_CANDIDATE only; not FAILED.
Overlapping active writes -> propagate blocking HARD convergence event; completed overlap stays non-blocking.
Integration receipt consumes a return -> unconsumed_returns decreases without rewriting worker return.
Unrelated main commit changes global EPOCH but not this Chat Object's semantic hash -> PRE_RESPONSE skips full Control Room load.
Fresh parent reincarnation recovers identical batch state with no transcript dependency.
Public projection passes privacy/falsification checks and contains no raw private payload.

evidence.proves: Control Room is a derived parent-awareness layer and parent continues useful work while workers run.
Human-memory optionality, missing-run semantics, independent worker state, partial/full awareness, no human result courier and stale-run recovery invariants.
Zero-memory parent behavior and durable launch-feedback semantics.
Parent refresh rule, independent worker writes, B-ZEROMEM pass and B-BIGPIC dispatchability.
Lifecycle states, no heartbeat loops, DONE/RETURN invariant and derived parent projection.
Return consumption is separate from return existence and worker completion.
Observed canary passed and compiled aggregate batch status remained an explicit implementation gap.
Current compiler discovers PACK workstreams and coordination/network workers but not delegated work-item run/return subtrees.
coordination/** changes already trigger runtime compile/test/publish, providing an event-like backend refresh path.
Runtime freshness advanced while multiple isolated B-BIGPIC scouts launched concurrently.
